questions.question: Why is Noritoshi Kamo considered one of Choso's parents?
questions.subject: Choso/Synopsis

answer.item: 150 years ago Noritoshi Kamo, the man who experimented on his mother is in fact his third "parent" due to him having mixed in his own blood into Choso when his mother was pregnant with him.

questions.question: Where were Choso and his brothers stored?
questions.subject: Choso/Synopsis

answer.item: At some point, Choso and his brothers were stored at Jujutsu High, along with some of Sukuna's fingers.

questions.question: Who took Choso and his brothers away from Jujutsu High?
questions.subject: Choso/Synopsis

answer.item: Choso and his brothers, along with Sukuna's fingers were taken from the Jujutsu High by Mahito.

questions.question: Why did Choso and his brothers side with the cursed spirits?
questions.subject: Choso/Synopsis

answer.item: Choso and his brothers are given bodies by Mahito and Choso and his brothers decide to side with the cursed spirits, since the world they envision will suit the brothers more.

questions.question: How did Choso defeat Yuji during the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Choso/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji tries to land a surprise attack with his bloodied arm that he hadn't used since the opening seconds of the fight, but Choso predicted the move and counters with a blow that knocks Yuji out, ending the fight.

questions.question: Why did Choso spare Yuji after knocking him out?
questions.subject: Choso/Synopsis

answer.item: Choso prepares to kill Yuji and finally avenge his brothers, but stops when a memory of all four of them sharing a meal together appears in his head.

questions.question: How did Choso force Kenjaku to reveal his innate technique?
questions.subject: Choso/Synopsis

answer.item: Choso proceeded to apply pressure on Kenjaku, ultimately forcing him into using his innate technique by activating three Supernovas surrounding him simultaneously.

questions.question: What did Choso hand to Yuji two days after Yuki died?
questions.subject: Choso/Synopsis

answer.item: Two days later, Choso met up with Yuji and handed him Yuki's records of soul research

questions.question: Why did Choso sacrifice himself for Yuji at the end of the fight?
questions.subject: Choso/Synopsis

answer.item: With Choso knowing that Sukuna's Divine Flame's heat would result in decompression and over-pressure within his Domain that would kill every living thing inside, Choso rushed to form a blood barrier to protect his brother at the cost of his own life.
